note: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file (dict-based). It contains no callable functions, classes, or CLI entry points — only variable assignments defining model architecture settings for SETR-PUP semantic segmentation.

review_backbone_settings: review the VisionTransformer backbone settings with 1024 embed dims and 24 layers
review_decode_head: review the SETRUPHead decode head config with 256 channels and 4 upsampling convolutions
review_auxiliary_heads: review the 3 auxiliary SETRUPHead configs each with 1 conv and 4x upscaling
review_data_preprocessor: review the SegDataPreProcessor config with ImageNet mean/std normalization
